name: Salisbury Steak with Mushroom Gravy, Roasted New Potatoes & Broccoli

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ lb new potatoes
½ lb cremini mushrooms
1 crown broccoli

instructions.primary_message: Halve potatoes and place on a baking sheet pan; drizzle with oil and season with spices. Toss to combine and spread out in an even layer.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tsp extra virgin olive oil
⅛ tsp basil, dried
⅛ tsp salt
⅛ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast until the potatoes start to soften, about 15 minutes.
Meanwhile, peel and mince garlic; peel and thinly slice onion. Transfer both to a medium bowl.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 clove garlic
½ medium yellow onion

instructions.primary_message: Thinly slice mushrooms, add to the bowl with the garlic and onion, and set aside.

Place beef, egg, bread crumbs, Dijon, Worcestershire, and spices in another medium bowl; mix with your hands until well combined. Form the beef mixture into 2 equal-sized patties and place on a plate.
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ lb lean ground beef
1 egg
¼ cup panko bread crumbs
1 tbsp Dijon mustard
1 tsp Worcestershire sauce
½ tsp thyme, dried
½ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add patties and cook, undisturbed, for 5 minutes; flip and pan-fry until cooked through, 3-4 minutes more. Once done, transfer to a clean plate (leaving the cooking juices in the skillet) and loosely cover with aluminum foil.
Meanwhile, separate broccoli into bite-sized florets and cut stems into smaller pieces.

Remove baking sheet from the oven; add broccoli, drizzle with additional oil, and season with salt and pepper. Stir to combine with the potatoes and return to the oven. Roast until the veggies are fork-tender, 10 minutes more.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tsp extra virgin olive oil
⅛ tsp salt
⅛ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Return the skillet (with cooking juices) to medium heat, add more oil, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add garlic, onion, and mushrooms; cook, stirring often, until softened, about 5 minutes.
Sprinkle flour into the skillet and cook, stirring constantly, until fragrant, about 1 minute. Add broth and Worcestershire, stir to combine, and bring the gravy to a boil.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp all-purpose flour
8 fl oz (1 cup) chicken or vegetable broth
1 tsp Worcestershire sauce

instructions.primary_message: Return patties to the skillet and cook, stirring occasionally, until the gravy has thickened and patties are warmed through, about 3 minutes. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide potatoes, broccoli, and beef patties between plates. Top patties with mushroom gravy and enjoy!
